4.  Section  431  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended by the addition immediately after subsection (6)
of that section, of the following new subsection: -
“(7)  Where  any  movable  property
owned  by  a  company  is  subject  to  a
floating  charge  which  is  registered
under  the  Secured  Transactions Act,
No.      of 2023, the provisions relating
to  priority  contained  in  that Act  shall
apply in determining the priority of such
floating charge.”.
5.  The  following  new  section  is  hereby  inserted
immediately after section 433 of the principal enactment
and shall have effect as section 433A of that enactment: -
“ Interpretation         433A. In this Part of this Act, the
term “floating charge” means a “security
right” for the purpose of the application
of  the  provisions  of    the  Secured
Transactions Act, No.   of 2023.”.
6.  In  the  event    of  any  inconsistency  between  the
Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall
prevail.
